motivation: Teacher-only original-parent holdout finds Gaussian exemplar regression generalizes teacher answers better than a residual MLP. This is not yet RMOT evidence.
algorithm: Gaussian residual regression on visible-prefix frozen PCD, source-logit offset, image-only bandwidth, fixed observation regularizer 0.1. Support variance gates MLP extrapolation toward kernel prediction.
bandwidth: median distance to tenth training neighbour, recomputed on visible prefix only
information_scope: Past and current teacher answers only, exact current-prefix saved KD outputs; no batch trained head, no global target normalization, no future-payload reads
baselines: strong batch KD is separately scoped
caveats: Gaussian variance is model-based support, not calibrated true RMOT error probability
cached source features and prepaid teacher answers, not cold live time
acceptance: full official metrics, parent-video paired intervals, CountMatched controls, final repeat seeds and real cost before goal completion
